html:
G'oya

Juftlik bu bitta buyurtmadagi ikki mahsulot. Ularni topish uchun order_items ni o'zi bilan order_id bo'yicha ulaymiz. a.product_id < b.product_id sharti har bir juftlikni bir marta qoldiradi va mahsulotni o'zi bilan juftlashtirmaydi. Keyin juftliklar bo'yicha guruhlab, har xil buyurtmalarni sanaymiz.

Yechim

SELECT a.product_id AS product1, b.product_id AS product2,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.order_id) AS orders
FROM order_items a
JOIN order_items b ON b.order_id = a.order_id AND a.product_id < b.product_id
GROUP BY a.product_id, b.product_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.order_id) >= 2

Namunada 1 va 2 mahsulotlar 100- va 101-buyurtmada, 2 va 3 esa 101- va 102-buyurtmada birga. 1 va 3 faqat 101-buyurtmada uchrashgan, ular chiqmaydi.

Tuzoqlar

Bitta buyurtmada mahsulot ikki qatorda yozilgan bo'lishi mumkin. Unda self join shu buyurtmadan bitta juftlikni ikki marta hosil qiladi va COUNT(*) bitta buyurtmani 2 deb sanaydi. Juftlik HAVING dan noto'g'ri o'tib ketadi:

Noto'g'riSELECT a.product_id AS product1, b.product_id AS product2, COUNT(*) AS orders
FROM order_items a
JOIN order_items b ON b.order_id = a.order_id AND a.product_id < b.product_id
GROUP BY a.product_id, b.product_id
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2

COUNT(DISTINCT a.order_id) qatorlarni emas, buyurtmalarni sanaydi.

< o'rniga <> yozilsa, har bir juftlik ikki marta chiqadi: (1, 2) va (2, 1).

Boshqa yo'l

Takroriy qatorlarni oldindan olib tashlash ham mumkin: SELECT DISTINCT order_id, product_id. Shundan keyin har bir buyurtmada mahsulot bir martadan uchraydi va oddiy COUNT(*) yetarli:

WITH items AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT order_id, product_id FROM order_items
)
SELECT a.product_id AS product1, b.product_id AS product2, COUNT(*) AS orders
FROM items a
JOIN items b ON b.order_id = a.order_id AND a.product_id < b.product_id
GROUP BY a.product_id, b.product_id
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
